title: GF(2^571) batch mul via multi-word VPCLMULQDQ
description:
## Current

`crates/gf2-core/src/gf2m/wide.rs` handles GF(2^m) for m > 64 via scalar multi-word arithmetic. m=571 (NIST B-571 / K-571 elliptic-curve research) currently has zero SIMD path — every multiply is 9×9 word-pair scalar XORs and shifts.

## Fix

PPC walk:

- V3 SIMD: 2D VPCLMULQDQ scheduler — process pairs of u64 word products per VPCLMULQDQ-on-YMM instruction, accumulate the partial-product matrix.
- V4 register tile: schedule the 9×9 word-pair fan to keep partial products in YMM registers as long as possible.

Wire via `simd::maybe_gf2m_wide()` (extend the existing `maybe_gf2m_wide256` if applicable, or add new).

## Per-kernel execution protocol

Same as C1. Bench: `gf2m_wide_mul.rs` (existing).

## Depends on

I1, I2, I3, I4.

## Success criteria

- [hard] Bit-exact vs. scalar wide multiply at m=571 across the existing test suite.
- [hard] Reduction polynomial handling unchanged (uses `primitive_polys` table).
- [aspirational] ≥1.5× geomean on `gf2m_wide_mul` bench at the m=571 size class.
